arms.name: Craft v3, parallel parts
arms.idea: craft3 split across concurrent calls: one planning call writes a shared spec (size, palette, mounts, skeleton, 3-6 parts), then one call per part writes a function into the shared builder, all at once; the runner assembles one module

arms.name: Craft v3, parallel parts, even work and box check
arms.idea: par with an even-work plan prompt (5-8 parts of equal work, the richest pieces split, every box inside the size at full reach) and a box check after assembly: each part is measured against its spec box and the floor without a model, every part reaching more than 15 cm out gets one low-effort edit call in its own part conversation, all at once, then the module is reassembled
